name: Glass Chess Required Update
notes: Adds a Stockfish engine icon and estimated strength rating beside the computer opponent
Adds a modern live evaluation rail to Analysis Studio with responsive board-side placement
Adds eight selectable Stockfish difficulty levels and shows the player's local Elo rating
Moves board themes, piece designs, colors, avatars, piece finishes, sounds and animation preferences into Settings
Fixes board theme persistence so Aurora, Royal, Sunset, Carbon and other themes remain selected after redraws
Refines the original Medieval and Modern chess-piece artwork
Adds checkmate confetti to the game-result popup
Expands King Pawn to general questions when the secure backend AI service is configured, with a chess-only offline fallback
Preserves automatic Live Engine Lab analysis and the Tools popup interaction fixes
